summary: Tests-only red-phase run for issue #5 (generated OpenAPI client). Committed VendoredOpenAPISpecTests (assertion-red: spec not vendored yet) and GeneratedAPIClientTests (compile-red: imports missing ColorMatchingOpenAPI module and generated Components.Schemas.* types). Contract deltas and endpoint gaps between docs/color-matching-api-contract.md and the published spec (viamin/color_matching#110, merged as upstream PR #113) are recorded in docs/openapi-client-migration-plan.md. No Swift toolchain exists in this container, so tests could not be executed locally; they run in CI (.github/workflows/ci.yml, macOS swift test). Expected assertion/compile failures demonstrating missing behavior are permitted in this phase; existing APIClientTests were left untouched (their 204 upload stubs must be updated by the implementation run).
